newsitem.title: UK: Palm, coconut oil unmoved by PNG political crisis.
newsitem.headline: Palm, coconut oil unmoved by PNG political crisis.

text.p: Palm oil and coconut oil markets have yet to be affected by political crisis in Papua New Guinea, European traders said.
Traders said there are some large plantations in PNG but so far these were unaffected by the troubles in Port Moresby and Lea.

"It's business as usual out on the plantations. They are about as far removed from the situation in Port Moresby and Lea as the average man in the street in the UK is from the (UK general election)... they've got lives, they're getting on with them." was the view of one European trader.
But "if it turned into country wide rioting then the situation could change," said another.
PNG produces around 30,000 to 35,000 tonnes of coconut oil and 225,000 to 250,000 tonnes of palm oil a year most of which is shipped to UK ports and Rotterdam.
